narrator_hint: seventh-storyteller / ending routes: several characters; work out the speaker from context

rows.en:
Heh heh heh...
There was a reason I told you this story, you know.
Today is Yuya's memorial: three years since he died.
And it's the day he promised he'd come back...
He was a truly sincere man.
So he's bound to come back.
Back to me...{p}

I hate liars.
He should know that better than anyone.
Even dead, I'm sure he'll keep his promise.
Yuya will come back. I know he will.{p}...You think so too, don't you, {a}?
I think so
I don't think so

"Iwashita...
You may be offended to hear me say this, but...
I don't think Igarashi is coming back."
...No matter what he promised, a dead person can't come back.
It's been three whole years since Igarashi died, and she's still clinging to a dead man...
Iwashita is alive, so I think she has to look ahead and live her life.
...But it seemed it would be hard to make her understand that...{p}

"Why would you say such a thing?
I didn't know you were such a cold person.
He will come back!"
Iwashita glared at me, her face white and taut.{p}
...And just then.

"...It's him."
Iwashita murmured.
...No way!
That can't be......{p}

"Yuya!
...It's you, Yuya, isn't it?"{p}
Iwashita smiled happily and rose from her chair.
Stop Iwashita and open the door myself
Don't let anyone open the door

"No!
Please don't open the door☆"
I shouted before I knew it.
Iwashita is going to be taken away...
For no reason at all, I couldn't shake that feeling.{p}

"No!
He's here.
Why can't I open it★"
"What do you mean, why...?
Igarashi is dead!"
"I know that much!"
In the eyes glaring sharply at me, I could clearly see the color of hatred.
"If you're telling me I can't open it, then I...{p}I'll kill you!"
Let Iwashita do as she likes
Stop Iwashita and open the door myself
Never let anyone open the door, no matter what

"Wait a moment, please.
The one outside the door might be the seventh person.
Let me handle this. I'll open the door.
The responsibility and authority for this meeting are mine, after all.
Iwashita, please go back to your seat.
...All right?"{p}

I stared steadily back into Iwashita's eyes...
And then...{p}

"...All right."
Iwashita blinked a few times and lowered her eyes.{p}

Standing on the other side of the door was a tall man with a handsome face...
"...This is the newspaper club, right?
Where the seven wonders meeting is...
I'm Igarashi, from Class 2-D..."
If he knows about the seven wonders, he must be the seventh one after all...?
...But wait a second.
Just now, he called himself 'Igarashi.'
Igarashi...★
If I remember right, Iwashita's dead fiancé's surname was Igarashi too...
...Which means he's a ghost★
"Sorry I'm late.
I'm still not used to this..."{p}
With that, Igarashi pulled the door shut with a soft thump.{p}

We held our breath and watched his every move.
...For a ghost, he seemed to have a lot of presence.
But for a living person, he was far too frail...
No one said it out loud, but I could see it in their looks, a mix of curiosity and unease.
Maybe sensing the mood, Igarashi looked around at us with a puzzled face.
"Um...?
Is something wrong, everyone?"
At that, everyone hurriedly looked away from Igarashi.
And then they kept glancing at me.
...Looks like I'm the one who has to do the talking.
I know!
"May I ask you one question?"
...I can judge who he really is from his answer.
Am I sharp or what!
"Sure, I don't mind."{p}Now then, what should I ask...?
About Iwashita
About the accident
About the afterlife
Why he came here

"Um...
Were you in a serious accident once?"
"You're well informed.
That's right."
...So he IS a ghost, then?
"I'd heard that you died in it..."

"What★
Who told you that?"
"Who? Well...
Iwashita did.
...Your fiancée."
"I see, so Akemi said that..."
With that, Igarashi lowered his eyes.
"Three years ago...
I really was in an accident, but by some miracle I survived.
I was badly hurt, though, so my hospital stay dragged on longer than expected, and I had no choice but to give up on studying abroad."
...Oh, so that's what happened.
He wasn't a ghost after all.
Why would Iwashita tell a lie like that?
Wondering about it, I turned around...{p}

...Iwashita was gone!
She was sitting in her chair just a moment ago...
Where did she go?
"Um, where's Iwashita...?"
"Huh...?
Now that you mention it, she's not here."
"She was here a second ago..."
Didn't anyone see her go?
'My sweetheart died'
...Maybe she told a lie like that, then got embarrassed and went to hide.
Hmm.
It's a shame, but I can't use a story that's a lie.
...As I was thinking about that,
"So Akemi was sitting in that seat..."
Igarashi murmured.{p}

"When I had my accident...
She was so shocked that she took to her bed.
She'd been in poor health to begin with, and she died in no time at all."
...What★
"W-wait a minute, please.
Are you saying Iwashita died three whole years ago?"
"That's right.
I just came from visiting her grave, after all...
...I see, so she said I was the one who died.
Akemi never knew that I survived..."{p}

As he said that, a single tear spilled from Igarashi's eye.
You don't often see a man cry, but somehow it was beautiful, like a scene from a movie...
"Igarashi..."
I quietly held out my handkerchief.
That very instant...!{p}

<Yuya...>
Iwashita's figure rose faintly into view outside the window.
Her sorrowful eyes were saying,
"Don't touch him...!"
Or so it seemed.
Startled, I stepped back, and she smiled an angelic smile...
<Yuya...>
In a voice like a tinkling bell, she called his name.{p}

Whether he could hear that voice or not...
Igarashi raised his face and stared blankly out the window.
The eyes of someone possessed.
<Yuya...>
Those eyes glinted, and Igarashi began to stagger forward.
"Akemi is lonely.
All alone...
...I have to go to her."
Step by step, he drew steadily closer to the window.{p}

In the darkness, the smiling figure of Iwashita swayed faintly...
Rattle...
Without anyone touching it, the window slid open with a clatter.
<Yuya...>
It seemed to me that Iwashita spread her arms wide.
That very instant...☆{p}

"I'm coming now.
To where you are..."
Murmuring that, Igarashi set his foot on the window frame and flung himself into the darkness in one leap.
His back shrank away in an instant...{p}

Then, scattering a spray of bright red blood, he stopped moving.
...It all happened in just a few seconds.{p}

"Oh no!
Someone jumped!"
A crowd quickly gathered around Igarashi.
Some of them were pointing up at us.
"It was from that window!"
...That's probably what they were saying.
The police would be here soon.
Would they suspect us of being the culprits?
.........No, of course not.
But after a commotion like this, our project will probably be canceled.{p}

<You've finally come to me, Yuya...>
<From now on, we'll be together forever...>
Amid the wail of approaching sirens, I thought I heard words like those pass between them...{p}

"Yes, I think so.
Igarashi will come back to keep his promise to you, even if he has to come back as a spirit."
...No matter what he promised, a dead person can't come back.
But Iwashita believes it so stubbornly...
So I'll try believing too.
Believing in Iwashita, who believes he'll come back...{p}

"Thank you, {a}...
Yes, he'll come back to me, won't he?"
As she said it, Iwashita's face was white as paper, and only her eyes shone, huge and glittering.
...Something about her felt eerie.
That's what I thought...{p}

"........."
I couldn't answer.
...No matter what he promised, a dead person can't come back.
But Iwashita was already hurting from losing her sweetheart, and I didn't want to deal her another blow.
…………………………………………………………………………………………………………………………………….
A long silence followed.
...What should I do?
Maybe she was waiting for a clear answer...
I'd started to think that.{p}
Before everyone's eyes, the door opened by itself.

Who was on the other side of the door...★
Every gaze was fixed on it.
But there was no one in the hallway.
"Huh, there's nothing here."
"Then what about that knocking?
And who just opened the door?"
"Ain't it just some sick prank?"{p}

Most of the members went back to their seats, looking deflated all at once.
Iwashita alone stayed standing there, dazed.
"Hey, {a}.
Take a look at this..."
Suddenly one of the boys in the group called out to me.{p}

He was crouching in the hallway, staring hard at the floor.
Then, pointing here and there...
"Look, here...
It's wet.
...And here too."
I followed where his finger pointed, and sure enough, there was a trail of small marks like little puddles, dotted along the floor.
"...They look like footprints."
He murmured it as if to himself.
The one who flinched at those words was Iwashita.{p}

You'd better remember this.
I will never forgive you.
I'll make you taste the same sorrow I've felt!"
"Iwashita..."
"Heh heh, I have nothing more to say to you.
Why don't you hurry on to the next one?"{p}

Iwashita turned away with a huff and went straight back to her seat.
The boy who'd kept examining the hallway to the end had taken his seat at some point too.
Feeling somehow unable to bear it, I closed the door.
Next is the sixth story...
Who should I ask to tell it...?{p}

"Absolutely not!
Listen, please, nobody touch the door."
I planted myself in front of the door and shouted at everyone as if to threaten them.
And then...{p}
With a click, the doorknob turned, and the door opened by itself.{p}

"Um...
Do you know Akemi Iwashita?"
"Yes, I know her.
She's the love of my life..."
...He must be a ghost after all.
"Um...
You're supposed to have died in an accident, though..."{p}

"Um...
Do you know anything about the afterlife?"
"Huh...?"
Igarashi looked puzzled.
...Maybe that question was a bit of a mistake.
"Um...
I heard that you died in an accident, though..."{p}

"Um...
Why did you come here?"
"Why? Well...
...Because I was called."
Called?
By Hino...?
Or by Iwashita...?
...Hmm, I can't tell.
"Um...
I heard that you died in an accident, though..."{p}
